dedupe_keys.name: the global south a site dataset for potential underground hydrogen storage

description: Ben Littlejohn and Vicente Sepulveda-Figueroa at the University of Canterbury compile potential underground hydrogen-storage sites in the Global South. The July 2026 deposit combines geological and techno-economic characteristics from publications, industry reports, technical reports and national databases. Entries retain source publications, dates, geographic locations and current status. Separate CSV exports cover cavernous and porous sites, alongside an Excel workbook. The files are free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage includes hydrocarbon fields, aquifers and salt caverns, but the public description does not state a complete country list, site count or common observation year. The compilation can support preliminary site selection and spatial storage-capacity simulations. A listed structure is a candidate, not evidence of validated hydrogen-storage suitability or permission to operate. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this compilation. The source harmonisation and underlying tables were not checked.
